mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 5.0% signals a tightening monetary policy regime that increases discount rates for equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS exceeds 5.0%, or the mean 20-day return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4.5% signals tightening labor market conditions that increase wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting the Fed to maintain restrictive policy and suppressing equity valuations over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases when UNRATE falls below 4.5%, or the average return in such periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts above 1.45 million units signals strong consumer demand and confidence, which drives forward equity returns over the next 60 trading days as firms anticipate higher future revenues.
failure_condition: Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03, or 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive in the presence of high HOUST (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production below 110.0 index level signals weakening manufacturing activity and economic contraction, which triggers risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO falls below 110.0, or the mean return in such periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in both residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates a synchronized surge in household demand for housing, which signals broad-based consumer confidence and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising RSAFS and HOUST fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction term in a regression model has a non-significant coefficient (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in CPIAUCSL above 207.0 combined with a stable FEDFUNDS rate signals persistent inflationary pressure without policy response, leading to real rate compression and negative equity returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances meeting the trigger condition, or the interaction term in a predictive model is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in payroll employment (PAYEMS) above 138,000 and a decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.5% signals a labor market overheating, which increases inflation expectations and triggers a preemptive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal fails to predict negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction effect in a regression model is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption (measured via RSAFS) above 370,000 million dollars combined with rising housing starts (HOUST) above 1.45 million units indicates strong aggregate demand, which drives forward equity returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings are expected to rise.
failure_condition: The joint signal fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction term in a predictive model has a non-significant coefficient (p > 0.05).
